note: On the north shore of 57-acre Pfeiffer Lake in mixed pine and hardwood forest; the lake shows through the trees from sites 12, 14 and 16 on the lower loop. Grassy swim beach, fishing pier, boat ramp, playground and a 3-mile hiking trail; two boat-in or hike-in backcountry sites on the lake are open year-round. The Forest Service says the sites are not designed for RVs, though most take a moderately sized vehicle. --Claude
